source.series: Befolkning 16-74 år efter region, utbildningsnivå, ålder och kön
source.note: Only post-2000 modern UREG history is used; the documented 2000 series break is not crossed.

method.transitionBasis: national cohort changes by sex and one-year age
method.estimation: For each lower state j, estimate p(j->j+1) from positive year-to-year increase in the national cohort share at or above state j+1 divided by the prior cohort share in state j; event-weighted over the locked 10-year window and clamped to [0,1].
method.simulation: Apply all adjacent promotions simultaneously to the prior cohort distribution, then age the cohort one year.
method.localStart: observed local education distribution by sex and age at each rolling origin

comparator.description: Carry each cohort's education shares forward unchanged as it ages.

evaluation.metric: mean absolute error in education shares across five states, sex and one-year age cells
developmentGate: candidate MAE must be strictly below identity qutb at n+1 for both Lulea and Lulea FA
candidate MAE must be no worse than identity qutb at n+2 for both Lulea and Lulea FA
all transition probabilities must be in [0,1] and education-state shares must sum to 1 within numerical tolerance
evaluation.governance: 2018-2024 is development evidence only. No state grouping, window, transition estimator, age range or clipping rule may be changed after results are viewed. Level 3 requires a separately locked external or future holdout.

governance.integrationRule: Even if this education model reaches level 4, it may only become a candidate explanatory layer for migration, fertility or mortality through separately locked component-specific models. It must never alter those demographic components merely by reaching level 4 itself.
governance.currentUse: standalone education-structure research and validation only
